kxrce01.title: San Francisco: The Fog Ate the Plan
kxrce01.caption:
Virgo laminated a six-stop night. The fog had other plans.
The best part of the night was the stop nobody planned. Who in your group makes the itinerary?

kxrce02.title: Portland: The Friend Who Always Cancels
kxrce02.caption:
Cancer typed "rain check?" for the fourth time. The friends were already at the door.
Tag the friend who needs an umbrella for three.

kxrce03.title: Washington, DC: The Fifth Seat
kxrce03.caption:
Two couples, one booth, and Capricorn holding the map.
Turns out the fifth seat planned the best night of everyone's year. Who's the fifth seat in your friend group?

kxrce04.title: Mexico City: My Ex Is at Every Stop
kxrce04.caption:
Tacos, mariachis, the big square: the ex was at every single one.
Scorpio ran out of places to hide and just said hi. Then churros. Would you hide or wave?

kxrce05.title: Tokyo: First Date vs the Last Train
kxrce05.caption:
First date, one hour until the last train, and they would not stop talking.
Cold noodles, one off-key song, zero regrets. Would you run for the train?

kxtve01.title: Friday Night: Out All Night vs In by Nine
kxtve01.caption:
2016 Sagittarius: three parties and pancakes at 2 a.m.
2026 Sagittarius: in bed by nine, breakfast for the same crew. Which Friday are you living right now?

kxtve02.title: Waiting Up for Their Reply
kxtve02.caption:
Sent "had fun today!" at 7. In 2016 that meant refreshing until 1 a.m.
In 2026 Gemini made dinner, went out and read the reply at breakfast. Which era are you in?

kxtve03.title: Two Hours Picking a Film
kxtve03.caption:
Ten years of couch nights. Two hours choosing, four minutes awake. Every single time.
The movie was never the point. Who falls asleep first in your house?

kxtve04.title: The Singles Table at the Wedding
kxtve04.caption:
2016: Virgo hid behind the flowers at the singles table.
2026: Virgo made joke name cards and led the conga line. Same table, very different energy. Which seat are you?
